hook: AI gave you a 5-paragraph essay when you needed a yes or a no.
caption:
AI gave you a 5-paragraph essay when you needed a yes or a no.

You asked: "Should I take the meeting?"

Generic AI said:
"There are several factors to consider when evaluating meeting opportunities. First, assess the potential value alignment with your goals. Second, consider your current bandwidth..."

You closed the tab.

---

Here's what's actually happening: AI doesn't know you hate hedging. It doesn't know you make decisions fast and just need someone to pressure-test your gut call — not write you a business school case study.

A BootFile-calibrated response to the same question:
"Lean yes — the connection is warm and you said relationship-building is a Q3 priority. 30 minutes won't kill your focus block. One thing to confirm first: do they have budget authority or are they a gatekeeper?"

Same AI. Completely different output.

The model isn't broken. It just doesn't know how your brain works yet.

That's the whole problem bootfile.ai exists to solve. Your thinking style, your communication preferences, your tolerance for nuance vs. directness — turned into a profile the AI actually uses.

Stop re-explaining yourself every single prompt.
